description: This file contains the implementation of a PHP class 'mantis' that provides an API wrapper for interfacing with a Mantis issue tracker. It includes methods for initializing cURL, retrieving issues, and managing HTTP requests, with placeholders for adding issues and notes.

classes.name: mantis
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to interact with a Mantis issue tracking system via REST API, supporting issue retrieval, creation, and linking functionalities, with internal methods for HTTP communication.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing class properties and cURL settings based on provided configuration.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes and configures the cURL handle with default or proxy settings.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches an issue by ID from the Mantis API.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Placeholder for method to add a new issue to Mantis.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Placeholder for method to add a note to an existing issue.

methods.name: addExternalLinks
methods.description: Placeholder for method to add external links related to an issue or card.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Placeholder for method to add tags to an issue or card.

methods.name: getMyUserInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the user associated with the API key.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Internal method to perform a GET request to the Mantis API.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request and decodes JSON response.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Handles the low-level cURL request, including headers, HTTP methods, and error handling.
